searchText: Reread my own statement and I had the same interpretation as you. Ten years living in the states and never learned to use punctuation in English 😆 . I played a bit with the explorer and found a couple more pools/large clients producing many more blocks than the expected with less than 200 votes. I start to think that perhaps it's a good thing to try to identify some and contact them to find out what's their setup. If they are running a particular client configuration that would be valuable debugging information Btw maybe a stupid question but is 2.0 the end? Or will there be a 3.0? 4.0? Is 2.0 the end of evolution? I can see a few wild ways to evolve the network. The core devs have a lot of improvements to the network that likely will go beyond sharddng. However, sharding is the end of the current roadmap, a new roadmap will need to be drafted after that. I think there are regrets for calling it Eth2.0. It's all just Ethereum and yes, there's a long road map of updates ahead <@124259917560414210> awesome I’m looking forward to the journey Hi guys, what sitesYou use to sell/ buy for good price? Hey please don’t ask these questions here. This discord is for research and development of the whole network itself. <#745072678079168654> any way to track the progress of eth 2.0 ? The fee's are worst than ever now 60$ to send 10 dollars is unacceptable.
